_scope: F26 performance, CPU only. Local simulation of wild creature bodies outside a fight; no save, network, combat or presentation state. Disabling restores a full move_and_slide every physics tick.

rest_slide_skip._comment: A wild creature standing still on its floor keeps its last collision result instead of re-sweeping its capsule every tick. Any requested move, velocity, impulse, burst, jump, external reposition or loss of floor runs a real slide the same tick; refresh_ticks forces a real slide at least that often while resting.
